name: Cafe & Restaurant Wanninger
kurzbeschreibung:
**Café & Restaurant Wanninger in Oberammergau**

Welcome to **Café & Restaurant Wanninger** in the heart of **Oberammergau**, where tradition meets modern charm. Nestled in the picturesque **Bayerische Alpen**, this cozy spot invites you to savor authentic Bavarian flavors in a warm, inviting atmosphere.

Indulge in our famous **Kaiserschmarrn**—fluffy, caramelized, and served with fresh fruit compote or a dusting of powdered sugar. For lunch, enjoy hearty **Schweinsbraten** with **Knödel** and a side of crisp **Sauerkraut**, or try our fresh **Bayerische Brezn** paired with a cold **Weißbier**.

After a day exploring the stunning **Ammergau Alps**, unwind with a cup of **Kaffee und Kuchen**—our homemade **Apfelstrudel** or **Vanillekipferl** are sure to delight. In the evening, savor a **Bayerische Brotzeit** with local cheeses, cured meats, and fresh bread.

Whether you're here for the **Passionsspiele Oberammergau**, a hike through the **Eibsee**, or simply to enjoy the alpine beauty, **Café & Restaurant Wanninger** is your perfect retreat. Come experience the warmth of Bavarian hospitality in this charming mountain village!
